title: Sequential composition of bounded executions
statement: Let $T,T_1$ be natural numbers, let $s_1,s_2$ be statements, and let $Q$ be a predicate on states. If $s_1$ has an execution from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T_1$ such that its final state admits an execution of $s_2$ with cost at most $T-T_1$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$, and $T_1 \le T$, then the sequential composition of $s_1$ followed by $s_2$ has an execution from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: The first statement has an execution from $\sigma$ of cost at most $T_1$
For every state satisfying the first execution's postcondition, the second statement has an execution of cost at most $T-T_1$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$
